core: NOD-like receptor sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
name: NOD-like receptor peptidoglycan sensing and inflammasome signaling
rationale: All members concern NOD1/2-type sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide and downstream innate signaling; inflammasome and K63-ubiquitination members distinguish it from the NOD1/NOD2-regulation and TAK1/JNK confusables.

name: Motile cilium assembly and multiciliated cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover axoneme, dynein arm, central apparatus and basal body assembly plus multiciliogenesis and mucociliary clearance, lacking the sperm-motility, ventricle, left-right asymmetry and tubulin-modification content of the confusables.

name: HDL and LDL remodeling with phospholipid efflux
rationale: Members concern HDL/LDL particle assembly and remodeling and ABC-transporter phospholipid efflux, whereas confusables emphasize cholesterol efflux regulation, LXR transcription or intestinal ABC transporter defects.

qualifier: p75NTR death and TRKA survival effectors
name: NGF signaling via p75NTR death and TRKA survival effectors
rationale: Members span p75NTR death signaling (NRAGE, NRIF, NADE, ceramide, dependence receptors) and NGF-TRKA downstream effectors (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB, PI3K), unlike confusables centred on TRKA activation, TRKB/TRKC or axon regeneration.

name: CDX-specified differentiated intestinal epithelium
rationale: Nearly all members describe the CDX/HNF4-driven differentiated intestinal epithelial programme (leukocyte migration is an outlier), distinguished from the intestine-plus-liver/kidney HNF4 modules, pancreatic lineage, antimicrobial and Wnt crypt confusables.

name: Glomerular mesangium and vasculature development and filtration
rationale: All members concern the glomerulus (mesangial cells, glomerular endothelium and vasculature, filtration, albumin absorption), unlike confusables on early metanephric and ureteric bud development.

name: Glycosylase-initiated base excision repair via NEIL1 and NEIL3
rationale: Members cover glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases, AP-site and strand-break resolution, with NEIL1/NEIL3 defects and ICL resolution distinguishing it from OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1, long-patch BER and alkylation-reversal confusables.

qualifier: memory B cells and adaptive memory
name: Memory B cell and activated lymphoid signature
rationale: Members are B cell, memory B cell and adaptive memory signatures of activated lymphocytes, distinct from naive B cell surface, germinal centre/Tfh and plasma cell confusables.

qualifier: MHC class I and II, cross-presentation
name: MHC class I and II antigen processing and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide loading and presentation on MHC I and II, proteasomal and endosomal processing and cross-presentation, unlike confusables centred on CD1/NKT lipid presentation, Nef CD4/CD8/CD28 downregulation or PD-L1 and proteasome biology.

name: O-fucosylation of thrombospondin type 1 repeat proteins
rationale: All three members concern O-fucose glycosylation of TSR domains and its B3GLCT (Peters plus) defect, unlike keratan sulfate and glycosaminoglycan confusables.

name: Phosphatidylinositol synthesis and ER–Golgi phospholipid transfer
rationale: Members concern PI synthesis and transfer of PI/PC between membranes, distinct from confusables on other glycerophospholipid synthesis and remodeling, flippases or Rab/Wnt trafficking.

name: p53 regulation driving p21-mediated G1 arrest
rationale: Members concern TP53 expression and co-factor control and its transcription of p21 and G1-arrest genes, unlike confusables on p53-driven apoptosis, G2 arrest or RB/E2F.

qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin metabolism, reuptake and psychostimulant response
name: Catecholamine and serotonin neurotransmission and psychostimulant response
rationale: Members cover dopamine, norepinephrine and serotonin synthesis, transport, degradation and receptor signaling plus behavioural responses to cocaine, amphetamine and ethanol, unlike cholinergic, neuropeptide-behaviour and GABA/glutamate transporter confusables.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis, transport and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members concern G6PC/G6PC3 and SLC37A4 glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis and transport and glucokinase control, distinct from glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glucagon-PKA and fructose/gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Atrial and ventricular compact myocardium morphogenesis
rationale: All three members concern atrial and ventricular compact muscle tissue morphogenesis, unlike trabecular, endocardial and heart-tube/second-heart-field confusables.

qualifier: sperm chromatin compaction and Y-linked genes
name: Spermatogenesis with sperm chromatin compaction and Y-linked genes
rationale: Members concern male germline maintenance, sperm DNA condensation, protamine exchange and Y-linked/spermatogenesis signatures, lacking the piRNA, imprinting and zygotic-transition content of the confusables.

name: Golgi glycoconjugate biosynthesis and nucleotide-sugar transport
rationale: Members cover Golgi N-glycan processing, O-glycosylation, proteoglycan/GAG and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar and PAPS transport, unlike confusables on lysosomal GAG degradation and dolichol/ER-stage glycosylation and GPI.

name: Eye and retina development, retinoid metabolism and phototransduction
rationale: Members span eye, retina and lens development, vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism and phototransduction defects, distinguished from inner-ear, ciliary-trafficking and placental confusables.

name: TLR-driven IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members concern IRAK1- and RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and positive regulation of canonical NF-kB in TLR signaling, unlike noncanonical NF-kB, TNFR1 and TAK1-induction confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, heterotypic adhesion, PECAM1 and leukocyte extravasation/diapedesis, unlike confusables on integrin-MAPK/Rap1 signaling, negative regulation of extravasation and immunological synapse.

name: Opsin light absorption and cone opsin deficiencies
rationale: All members concern opsins, light absorption and OPN1LW/MW/SW loss of function, distinct from retinoid cycle and phototransduction cascade confusables.

qualifier: endothelial fate specification and BMP signaling
name: Endothelial specification, arterial morphogenesis and BMP signaling
rationale: Members cover endothelial, arterial, venous and lymphatic fate, great-artery and outflow tract morphogenesis and positive BMP/SMAD signaling, unlike confusables on BMP/Nodal antagonism, adherens junctions or coronary vasculogenesis.

qualifier: post-lanosterol and oxysterol bile acid branches
name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover the Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell routes and bile acid synthesis via 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol, lacking the mevalonate/lanosterol and CYP-defect content of the confusables.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members concern scavenger receptor classes, efferocytosis and immune complex clearance and hyaluronan degradation, unlike confusables on oxidised LDL/foam cells, amyloid-beta clearance and microglia.

name: Podocyte nephrin signaling and cytoskeletal organization
rationale: The three members concern podocyte nephrin-family interactions, migration and cortical microtubule organization, distinct from generic filopodium, epithelial polarity and lamellipodium confusables.
